algorithm: Apply events in increasing revision order after verifying immutable identity, parent_revision, and previous_event_digest. The first three revisions are the pre-publication assembly history of Activation 001; Revision 4 is the first hardened candidate that binds object definitions and deterministic projection policy.

operations.FRONTIER_CREATED: Initialize root semantic fields and reference ids.
operations.FRONTIER_AMENDED: Add workstream and lineage register references and open question ids.
operations.FRONTIER_HARDENED: Add policy references and remaining open question ids.
operations.FRONTIER_HARDENED_OBJECTS: Bind canonical object registry, revision manifest, and projection policy.

historical_note: Revision 1-3 were mutable during pre-publication construction and are preserved as development history. After Revision 4 publication, frontier revisions are append-only and immutable.
